endorsements.quote: Trust calibration, however, carries an inherent temporal dimension.

unlisted_practices: Teach reviewing AI-generated clinical documentation to trainees as a defined competency with four domains: error detection, clinical reconciliation, independent generation, and trust calibration.
Use simulation-based education with planted errors in AI-generated notes to teach and assess trainee documentation review.
Include periodic AI-off note-writing exercises, distributed at regular intervals, so trainees preserve independent authoring ability.
Keep the earliest stages of training authoring-predominant and introduce ambient AI review only after foundational authoring and clinical reasoning are established.
Sequence ambient AI documentation review training by increasing difficulty and cognitive load, and reinforce it through spaced repetition.
Have trainees compare their self-rated review confidence against measured error-detection performance to build trust calibration.
Study empirically whether ambient AI use erodes trainees' independent authoring ability and clinical reasoning.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/framework article arguing for training and a competency framework for trainees reviewing ambient AI clinical documentation.
